product.name: Residential Developments
product.description: Marakez develops residential properties including apartments, penthouses, and homes in various locations across Egypt.

product.name: Office Spaces (District 5 Work)
product.description: Marakez provides office spaces ranging from 160 to 690 sqm, suitable for entrepreneurs, startups, and growing enterprises.

product.name: Retail Malls
product.description: Marakez develops and manages retail malls featuring a variety of shops, dining, entertainment, and essential services.

product.name: Mixed-Use Developments

product.name: Entertainment Facilities
product.description: Marakez includes entertainment venues and family-friendly recreational areas within its developments and malls.
